user_prompt:
Publication-quality 2D chemical skeletal structure diagram for TCM research paper. Grid layout: 2 rows x 3 columns, clean white background, black bond lines with warm accent colors on key functional groups. Hand-drawn academic style.

TOP ROW (left to right):
1. Forsythoside A (连翘酯苷A): Phenylethanol glycoside. Show 3,4-dihydroxyphenethyl alcohol linked via ester bond to caffeic acid (trans double bond, two hydroxyl groups on phenyl ring), with rhamnosyl-glucoside sugar chain. Label: 'Forsythoside A / 连翘酯苷A'
2. Berberine (小檗碱): Protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid. Four fused rings (A,B,C,D). Ring A: methylenedioxy group (-OCH2O-). Ring D: methoxy groups at positions 9,10. Nitrogen (N+) in B-C ring junction shown as quaternary ammonium. Highlight the aromatic ring system in pale amber. Label: 'Berberine / 小檗碱'
3. Linderane (乌药内酯): Sesquiterpene lactone. Bicyclic structure with gamma-butyrolactone (-C(=O)-O-) fused to a cyclohexane ring. Include the furan ring and characteristic double bonds. Label: 'Linderane / 乌药内酯'

BOTTOM ROW (left to right):
4. Polydatin (虎杖苷): Stilbene-3-O-beta-D-glucoside. Show: left phenyl ring (unsubstituted), trans double bond (-CH=CH-), right phenyl ring (3,5-dihydroxy), attached at C-3 hydroxyl to beta-D-glucopyranose ring (shown as Haworth projection or chair form). Label: 'Polydatin / 虎杖苷'
5. Paeoniflorin (芍药苷): Monoterpene glucoside. Bicyclic pinane skeleton with lactone bridge, benzoate ester group (-OC(=O)-Ph), and beta-D-glucopyranose. Show the cage-like bicyclic framework. Label: 'Paeoniflorin / 芍药苷'
6. Chlorogenic acid (绿原酸): 3-O-Caffeoylquinic acid. Show quinic acid cyclohexane ring with four hydroxyl groups, ester bond at C-3 position connecting to caffeic acid chain (trans -CH=CH- with 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group). Label: 'Chlorogenic acid / 绿原酸'

Title at top in bold: Chemical Structures of Core Blood-Entering Components of 6 TCM Herbs
Subtitle: 6味中药核心入血成分化学结构
Style: Clean academic, thin black bond lines, molecular labels in small clean font, warm pale yellow background tint for each compound panel, no decorative elements

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements

IMPORTANT - NO FIGURE NUMBERS:
- Do NOT include "Figure 1:", "Fig. 1", or any figure numbering in the image
- Do NOT add captions or titles like "Figure: ..." at the top or bottom
- Figure numbers and captions are added separately in the document/LaTeX
- The diagram should contain only the visual content itself
